stories.title: Trump creates committee to investigate Fed Governor Lisa Cook
stories.summary: President Trump announced a three-person White House committee to weigh mortgage-fraud allegations against Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook, with a closed-door hearing set for Nov. 5. It is the latest step in his effort to remove a Fed governor the Supreme Court has so far allowed to stay in office.

stories.title: Magnitude 7.6 earthquake strikes Panama, triggers tsunami warnings
stories.summary: A 7.6-magnitude earthquake hit near Pitaloza Arriba in southern Panama on Friday afternoon, prompting tsunami warnings along Pacific coasts in Central and South America. The USGS estimates about 1.7 million people felt strong shaking or worse.

stories.title: Trump rules out striking Iran before the US midterms
stories.summary: Trump said on Truth Social that the US will not attack Iran before the Nov. 3 midterm elections, saying Washington is holding 'productive discussions' with Tehran even as reports surfaced that the Pentagon drafted strike options. The remarks follow a spike in oil prices and deepening uncertainty over the US-Iran standoff.

stories.title: Navi Pillay wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
stories.summary: The Norwegian Nobel Committee awarded the 2026 Peace Prize to Navi Pillay, the former UN human rights chief and international judge, citing her work to prosecute war crimes and genocide. Israel and Trump allies attacked the choice, while UN and rights officials praised it as a defense of international law.

stories.title: Automattic loses its interim CFO weeks after boardroom shakeup
stories.summary: Automattic, the parent of WordPress.com and Tumblr, has lost its interim chief financial officer just weeks after a boardroom shakeup, per TechCrunch. The departure adds to leadership churn as the company resets its executive ranks.

stories.title: Tesla renames 'Full Self-Driving' to 'Tesla Assisted Driving' in Europe
stories.summary: Tesla changed the name of its driver-assistance system in Europe to 'Tesla Assisted Driving' after Germany's transport ministry called 'Full Self-Driving' misleading. The retreat could ease the way for wider adoption of the paid software across the continent.

stories.title: Cloudflare acquires Deno
stories.summary: Cloudflare is acquiring Deno, the runtime behind the Deno and Node-compatible JavaScript toolchain, the two companies announced. Deno says it will keep shipping the runtime for another year before ending development, with the codebase staying open source.

stories.title: Licence-plate surveillance firm Flock cuts 18% of staff
stories.summary: Flock Safety, the AI-powered license-plate and camera surveillance company, is cutting about 270 jobs, or 18% of its workforce, via a voluntary buyout, Reuters reported. The cuts follow mounting privacy backlash and legal scrutiny of its mass-surveillance systems.

stories.title: Jets rule out Breece Hall and Adonai Mitchell for Browns game
stories.summary: New York Jets coach Aaron Glenn said running back Breece Hall and wide receiver Adonai Mitchell are out for Sunday's meeting with Cleveland. It knocks two of the Jets' top offensive weapons out of a Week 5 matchup against a Browns defense that has carried a 3-1 start.

stories.title: Browns work through injury designations ahead of Jets trip
stories.summary: Cleveland finalized its Week 5 injury lists Friday as it prepares to visit the New York Jets, with defensive linemen Mason Graham and Mike Hall Jr. among the names being tracked. The team has already ruled Graham out, leaving its interior front shorthanded.

stories.title: Mason Graham ruled out for Week 5 at the Jets
stories.summary: The Browns declared rookie defensive tackle Mason Graham out for Sunday's game at New York after he sprained an MCL and ankle in the Week 4 win over Pittsburgh. Mike Hall Jr.'s status is also under cloud as Cleveland reshuffles its defensive front.

stories.title: Browns news roundup: defense carries a 3-1 start into Week 5
stories.summary: Cleveland's October 9 newswire roundup notes the 3-1 Browns keep winning despite middling offensive stats, leaning on a defense that 'never rests.' Coverage also tracks the team's young receiver duo against prior rookie classes.

stories.title: Buckeye Talk: which CFP hopeful is Ohio State's biggest threat?
stories.summary: Cleveland.com's Ohio State beat answers subscriber questions before Saturday's homecoming date with Maryland, calling this the last tune-up before a pivotal stretch at Indiana and USC and home vs. Oregon. The mailbag flags Texas as the CFP contender most worth worrying about.

stories.title: Freshman receivers could start for Ohio State vs. Maryland
stories.summary: With Devin McCuin and Brandon Inniss unexpectedly listed questionable, true freshmen Chris Henry Jr. and Brock Boyd could make their first career starts alongside Jeremiah Smith. It is a notable test of Ohio State's receiver depth ahead of a demanding October stretch.

stories.title: Game theories and score picks for Ohio State vs. Maryland
stories.summary: The Bill & Doug Show lays out how Saturday's homecoming game could unfold, projecting a lopsided Buckeyes win (48-13 and 49-17 calls) behind Julian Sayin and Jeremiah Smith. Maryland arrives 2-3 and winless in Big Ten play, with coach Mike Locksley under pressure.

stories.title: Five Ohio State starters questionable for Maryland
stories.summary: Ohio State's availability report lists five projected starters as questionable for Saturday, including receivers Devin McCuin and Brandon Inniss, right tackle Phillip Daniels, linebacker Christian Alliegro and nickelback Jay Timmons. The Buckeyes are heavy favorites but could be thin on both sides.

stories.title: FIA admits 'human error' left overtake mode off in Singapore sprint qualifying
stories.summary: Formula 1's governing body confirmed that a Race Control mistake meant the new overtake mode was unavailable after the SQ1 red flag at Marina Bay, affecting cars differently depending on where they were on track. It is the second technical blunder in a week, after software glitches disrupted the Malaysian Grand Prix start.

stories.title: Mercedes' new upgrade laid bare by Singapore sprint qualifying
stories.summary: George Russell qualified second in the older-spec Mercedes, 0.573s ahead of team-mate Kimi Antonelli, who ran the new package. The Race reports the upgrade has a narrow balance window, leaving Mercedes with 'head scratching' over why it is not delivering the expected step.

stories.title: Verstappen takes Singapore sprint pole as timing chaos hits qualifying
stories.summary: Max Verstappen secured provisional sprint pole at Marina Bay ahead of George Russell after a chaotic SQ1 that featured a red flag and a timing-system failure, but faces a stewards investigation over allegedly overtaking Lewis Hamilton under yellow flags. It is Verstappen's first time topping qualifying at the Singapore street circuit.

stories.title: Russell handed 40-place grid penalty for Singapore
stories.summary: Stewards confirmed a combined 40-place grid drop for George Russell after Mercedes fitted four additional power-unit elements, sanctioning him to the back for Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix. The penalty does not apply to his sprint starting position, where he lines up alongside Verstappen.

stories.title: Trump urges Columbus to restore its namesake statue
stories.summary: In an Oct. 9 speech, President Trump demanded that the Christopher Columbus statue 'be put back into the heart of Columbus, Ohio,' reigniting a long-running local debate over the monument. The city removed the statue in 2020 amid nationwide protests.

stories.title: Columbus leaders demand an affordable-housing action plan
stories.summary: Community leaders, including the Columbus Urban League and NAACP, pressed city and county officials for a comprehensive affordable-housing plan, saying the region is in crisis mode. The Urban League says it has fielded more than 12,000 calls since July from residents at risk of losing their homes.

stories.title: Central Ohio sweep nets 200-plus traffic stops
stories.summary: A 12-hour 'Operation Unity' across Franklin County's Clinton Township area produced more than 200 traffic stops, 84 citations and 10 distracted-driving tickets, authorities said. It was the third such multi-agency operation this year, following a deadly summer of crashes.

stories.title: Columbus Council funds expansion of violence-intervention team
stories.summary: Columbus City Council voted to keep funding the Columbus Urban League's neighborhood violence-intervention program for another year with $725,000, doubling its on-call response team from four to eight. The program, started 13 years ago, sends responders into the community around the clock.
